hooks.command: repo="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || { echo "stop-hook: cannot resolve repo root from cwd=$PWD" >&2; exit 127; }; bash "$repo/bootstrap/run-stop-hook.sh"
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/bootstrap/mirror.sh" to-claude "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
